Messages.Author: Alan Kwan
Messages.Body:
When a Malkavian performs an action with the Madness Network in
another Meth's turn, can the acting minion and other friendly
minions play reaction cards (since it is not my turn)?

For example, if my Malk calls a vote to burn the Elysium (thereby
/not/ having to play an action card to call a vote), can the
Malk play /both/ a Bewitching Oration /and/ a Dread Gaze to gain
8 votes? Can other friendly vampires play Dread Gaze /and/
Surprise Influence to gain 4 or 6 votes each?

--
"Live Life with Heart."

Alan Kwan kw...@cs.cornell.edu

Peace Alan,

Looking at it officially, the acting minion can definitely play BO and
can probably play DG, though I'll have to recheck "reaction." You can
neither play DG nor SI as it is your turn and you can only play reaction
cards when it is not your turn.

Messages.Author: CurtAdams
Messages.Body:
kw...@cs.cornell.edu (Alan Kwan) wrote:
>
> When a Malkavian performs an action with the Madness Network in
> another Meth's turn, can the acting minion and other friendly
> minions play reaction cards (since it is not my turn)?
>
> For example, if my Malk calls a vote to burn the Elysium (thereby
> /not/ having to play an action card to call a vote), can the
> Malk play /both/ a Bewitching Oration /and/ a Dread Gaze to gain
> 8 votes? Can other friendly vampires play Dread Gaze /and/
> Surprise Influence to gain 4 or 6 votes each?

By the official ruling: oh yes; not your turn; Gaze and Influence away.
However, by the official ruling, you can't call most votes (no action
cards). You COULD vote to torch the Elysium.

By either of the fixes proposed in LSJ's house rules, you CAN call any
vote, but you CAN'T Gaze or Influence (no reactions).

Curt Adams (curt...@aol.com)

>By the official ruling: oh yes; not your turn; Gaze and Influence away.
>However, by the official ruling, you can't call most votes (no action
>cards). You COULD vote to torch the Elysium.

Well, as much as I wouldn't care if the above was true (and go on playing
the game the logical way), you really can't use Dread Gaze nor Surprise
Influence (even in the official view) because:

1. You have to be untapped to play those cards, and the Malk is tapped
before the vote can even start.

2. The rules state that (in addition to only being played when not your
turn) reaction cards can only be played in response to another
*player's* minion's actions - so you couldn't play Dread Gaze with
any of your other Minions either. [13.2]

>By either of the fixes proposed in LSJ's house rules, you CAN call any
>vote, but you CAN'T Gaze or Influence (no reactions).

True.
